codeReview.summary: Comprehensive implementation of the Correlation dashboard page with three tabs (Signals, Groups, Config). All 12 files changed are well-structured and follow project conventions (shadcn/ui, SWR hooks, Tailwind with theme variables, font-mono throughout). Feature description requirements are fully met: source status cards with health dots, recent signals table, weight visualization, filterable groups with cursor pagination and URL param sync, config editor with admin gating, signal source CRUD, per-playbook overrides, sidebar nav with badge, command palette entry with g r shortcut, keyboard shortcut, and 15 tests. A few non-blocking issues noted below.

issues.description: Misuse of useState as a side-effect: `useState(() => { setName(...); setWeight(...); setType(...) })` is used to 'sync form when initialName/initialConfig change', but useState initializer only runs on first render, so this has no effect on prop changes. It should be useEffect with a dependency array on [initialName, initialConfig], or removed entirely since handleOpenChange already resets state on dialog open. In practice the bug is masked because the Dialog remounts, but this is still incorrect React usage.
Unused import: `useSWRConfig` is imported from 'swr' but never used in the component. Should be removed to keep the import list clean.
Unused import: `useEffect` is imported from React but never used in the component. Should be removed.

No confirmation dialog for source deletion. handleDeleteSource immediately calls the API without user confirmation. The project uses AlertDialog for destructive actions (see admin/page.tsx for user deletion, mitigations-content-live.tsx for withdraw). Adding an AlertDialog for 'Remove' would be consistent with existing patterns.

getSignalSources() fetches up to 1000 events via getEvents({ limit: 1000 }) to derive source health status. This is a potentially expensive client-side computation for busy deployments. The 30s SWR refresh interval helps, but a dedicated backend endpoint (e.g., GET /v1/signal-sources) would be more efficient. Acceptable as-is for MVP since the feature description allows deriving from events.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used AlertDialog for destructive actions elsewhere in the project (admin page user deletion, mitigation withdraw) but did not use it for signal source deletion in the Config tab. AGENTS.md doesn't explicitly call out the 'use AlertDialog for destructive actions' convention. Adding this convention would prevent future inconsistencies.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: frontend/components/dashboard/correlation/config-tab.tsx:248 — handleDeleteSource calls API directly without confirmation. Compare to frontend/app/(dashboard)/admin/page.tsx which uses AlertDialog for user deletion.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend coding conventions in mission AGENTS.md don't mention avoiding unused imports, but the build step and linting may not catch them either (Next.js build doesn't fail on unused imports). This could accumulate tech debt.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: config-tab.tsx:4 imports useSWRConfig (unused), groups-tab.tsx:3 imports useEffect (unused)

summary: Pass. The implementation fully covers the feature description with all three tabs (Signals, Groups, Config), SWR hooks, API functions, sidebar nav with badge, command palette entry, keyboard shortcut, and 15 tests. Code follows project conventions well. Found 5 non-blocking issues: misuse of useState as side-effect (masked by dialog remount), two unused imports, missing deletion confirmation dialog, and a performance note about client-side source status derivation. None of these are blocking — the feature works correctly and tests pass.
